families.name: Spot trend with cash
families.hypothesis: Slow investor adjustment produces continuation over days rather than minutes.
families.entrySketch: Daily close above SMA200 and positive trailing 90-day return; enter after the closed signal.
families.exitSketch: Exit after daily SMA200 break or predeclared risk stop.
families.lineage: Related to failed regime trend/breakout V1; not a validated new edge.

families.name: Institutional demand event response
families.hypothesis: Verified demand events may contain information not immediately incorporated into price.
families.entrySketch: Study a predeclared signed 24-hour excess return after first publication; no orders.
families.exitSketch: End event measurement at the frozen horizon.
families.failureRegime: Announcements already priced in or correlated with market moves
families.lineage: New proposed event mechanism relative to inspected families; global repository novelty unverified.

families.name: Conditional bearish relative weakness
families.hypothesis: Relative weakness may predict additional losses when the broad market is falling.
families.entrySketch: First validate lagged relative weakness conditional on a predefined negative market regime.
families.exitSketch: Trading exits require a later preregistered design after feature validation.
families.failureRegime: Weak assets rebound and relative losers still rise
families.lineage: Not a rescue of failed taker-flow shorts; no asset exclusions based on prior losses.

families.name: Stress portfolio hedge
families.hypothesis: A small systematic short hedge may reduce extreme spot portfolio losses after its insurance cost.
families.entrySketch: Enter a capped hedge after a lagged volatility stress trigger and negative market direction.
families.exitSketch: Reduce at next executable point after stress clears; never widen risk stops.
families.failureRegime: Repeated hedge cost and rapid market rebound
families.lineage: Evaluate incremental portfolio protection, not hedge profit alone.

families.name: Shock and reclaim daytrader
families.hypothesis: Temporary one-sided liquidity pressure can exhaust and reverse after a confirmed reclaim.
families.entrySketch: Closed 5m move >=3 prior ATR14 and volume >=3 prior 20-bar median; within next 3 closed bars reclaim shock midpoint; reverse signs for short. Enter only afterward.
families.exitSketch: Stop beyond shock extreme plus 0.25 prior ATR; target 1.5R; maximum 6 bars; one attempt per event.
families.failureRegime: Fundamental trend resumes after temporary bounce
families.lineage: Distinct reversal hypothesis from failed breakout continuation; do not label liquidation or whale without actual feeds.

families.name: Stable residual pair reversion
families.hypothesis: A previously stable relative price residual may mean-revert without relying on market direction.
prerequisites: Hedge ratio estimation without future data
families.entrySketch: Validate BTC/ETH residual stability first; draft 90-day hourly hedge estimate, entry residual z beyond +/-2.
families.exitSketch: Draft exit |z|<0.5, stop |z|>3.5 or 24h; both legs synchronized and costed.
families.failureRegime: Structural relationship break and asynchronous fills
families.lineage: Not an inventory grid; preregister independently and verify novelty in complete registry.

families.name: Defensive spot low volatility
families.hypothesis: Defensive low-volatility selection with cash may improve drawdowns and risk-adjusted spot outcomes.
prerequisites: Exact frozen LowVol V2 source audit
New independent validation of changed exposure
families.entrySketch: Draft weekly top 3 lowest trailing 30-day volatility assets among daily close>SMA200; maximum 25% each; minimum 25% cash.
families.exitSketch: Daily closed SMA200 break exits at next executable price; weekly rank rebalance.
families.failureRegime: Low historical volatility fails during broad selloff
families.lineage: Separate long-only derivative of known LowVol family; frozen V2 stays unchanged and its PASS does not transfer.

families.name: Classified whale flow information
families.hypothesis: Unusual verified external exchange flows may add information beyond contemporaneous price and volume.
families.entrySketch: Native external exchange transfer above prior 30-day 99.5 percentile; exclude internal transfers/mint/burn; separately test inflow-negative and outflow-positive 60-minute excess returns from actual receipt.
families.exitSketch: Feature study ends at 60 minutes; no trade before separate feature PASS and trading preregistration.
families.failureRegime: Internal relabeling, delayed alerts, transfers unrelated to trades
families.lineage: Not a relabeled taker-flow V1/V2; both known flow lines remain failed.

families.name: Dated futures basis convergence
families.hypothesis: A dated futures basis may converge sufficiently to cover financing, spread and capital costs.
prerequisites: Dated contract availability and settlement terms
families.entrySketch: Study executable spot/futures paired entry only when net locked basis exceeds declared full costs and buffer.
families.exitSketch: Exit at settlement or predeclared spread/risk limit; model both legs.
families.failureRegime: Margin stress, settlement mismatch and costly exit
families.lineage: Distinct from perpetual cross-venue funding; full-family audit still required.

families.name: Funding settlement demand distortion
families.hypothesis: One-sided carrying costs may alter marginal demand around actual funding settlements.
families.entrySketch: Preregister event excess returns around true venue funding timestamps using information known before settlement.
families.exitSketch: End at fixed event horizon; trading design only after feature validation.
families.failureRegime: Expected effects arbitraged away and changing settlement conventions
families.lineage: Separate feature question, not a claim that existing CV2 funding research is new.

families.name: Announced index rebalance demand
families.hypothesis: Preannounced rules-based index rebalances can create measurable execution demand.
prerequisites: Verified historical announcements and effective times
families.entrySketch: Study predeclared signed effect between first announcement and effective timestamp against matched controls.
families.exitSketch: End at fixed post-effective horizon; no portfolio at feature stage.
families.failureRegime: Too few events, anticipatory trading and data revisions
families.lineage: Novelty relative to entire repository unverified; no hindsight winner selection.

families.name: Causal regime risk allocator
families.hypothesis: Lagged regime-based risk allocation may improve a validated specialist portfolio versus fixed weights after costs.
prerequisites: Frozen weights and point-in-time regime code
Same future specialist paths for fixed-weight control
No use of realized future winning strategy
families.entrySketch: Daily closed data: stress if 20d volatility exceeds preceding 365d 90th percentile; otherwise bull close>SMA200 and SMA50 rising over 5d, bear inverse, else range. Require 2 matching days except stress; next executable decision.
families.exitSketch: Apply frozen regime weights only to independently validated specialists; missing specialist means cash; existing stops never widened.
families.failureRegime: Regime misclassification, switching costs and shared specialist risks
families.lineage: Meta-allocation, not independent alpha; shadow comparison after specialist validation; one EUR10000 portfolio, not sum of test accounts.
